CROSSTRADE APIMANAGEMENT APINT8 CONNECTIONSCONNECT NT8 CONNECTION
On this page
Connect NT8 Connection

Ask NinjaTrader to connect to an existing broker or data-provider connection. Use its name from List NT8 Connections.

ELITE

Requires an Elite subscription and a connected CrossTrade add-on. NinjaTrader must already be running. See Authentication.

Endpoint​

POST https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/manage/nt8/connections/connect

Headers​
NAME	REQUIRED	VALUE
Authorization	Yes	Bearer <your API token>
Content-Type	Yes	application/json

This live command has no saved resource version. Omit If-Match; sending it returns 400 unsupported_precondition.

Body parameters​
NAME	TYPE	REQUIRED	DESCRIPTION
name	string	Yes	Configured NT8 connection name, matched without regard to case. 1 to 128 characters, without leading/trailing whitespace, control characters, ; or =

Unknown fields and query parameters are rejected. The connection must appear in your add-on's inventory. The command uses credentials already configured in NinjaTrader.

Code examples​
Python
cURL
import requests



resp = requests.post(

    "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/manage/nt8/connections/connect",

    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"},

    json={"name": "Rithmic"},

)

print(resp.status_code, resp.json())

Response​
{

  "success": true,

  "changed": true,

  "data": { "name": "Rithmic", "action": "connect", "requestStatus": "acknowledged" },

  "changedFields": [],

  "delivery": { "status": "requested", "target": "nt8_addon" },

  "warnings": [],

  "meta": { "requestId": "req_9f2c1a0b7d3e4f51" }

}


200 means the add-on acknowledged the command. It does not confirm that broker login or market-data connection has finished. Poll List NT8 Connections and inspect status and priceStatus for confirmation.

Here, changed: true means acknowledgement. No saved settings changed, so changedFields is empty and the response has no ETag. The command is not queued for delivery after an add-on reconnect.

Errors​
STATUS	ERROR	WHEN
400	invalid_json, unknown_parameter, unsupported_precondition	Invalid JSON, query parameters, or an If-Match header
401	unauthorized	Missing or invalid API token
403	elite_required, not_available	See Authentication
404	connection_not_found	The name does not resolve to one configured connection
409	addon_disconnected, concurrent_modification	The add-on is offline, or another connection command is in progress
415	unsupported_content_type	The body is not UTF-8 JSON
422	validation_failed	Missing, invalid, or unknown body fields
429	rate_limited, too_many_concurrent_requests	See Rate limits
503	addon_unavailable	Inventory could not be read; no connect command was issued
503	outcome_unknown	The command was attempted without a successful acknowledgement. Read live status before retrying
503	management_unavailable, management_read_only, family_unavailable, management_busy	See Errors
Reconnecting​

Call Disconnect, poll until disconnected, then call this endpoint and poll until connected. There is no combined reconnect endpoint. Existing reconnect-action settings still apply.

Each connect request costs 2 change-budget units. Acknowledged and uncertain command attempts appear in GET Audit under family=nt8_connections.
